items.title: Earl Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and states he is filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive; Interviewee responds 'My pleasure.'

ctx.x: Earl was interviewed in San Francisco, California on August 7, 2002 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive today in San Francisco and I’m very pleased to have Earl Watkins with me.
